messages:
Asha (Partnerships): quick sync 1 need a compact rules-of-engagement for SI co-sell when marketplace and SI both touch an account. We're finalizing AtlasHW marketplace listing and want clarity before launch.

Gavin (Marketplace): baseline: marketplace-first for paid checkout + trial signups. but exceptions exist if SI has demonstrable prior work.

Omar (SI-Partner): from partner POV we need a short claim process. propose 10-day claim window after first SI engagement and evidence types: signed MOU, partner-signed SOW, meeting minutes on partner domain. Screenshots alone not accepted.

Nina (Legal): agree on evidence types. add requirement that MOU/SOW includes partner DRI and customer name + date. legal will draft template wording for partner addendum.

Rory (Ops): to be deterministic we need these fields in CRM: origin_source, partner_claim_ts, evidence_type, evidence_url, first_paid_ts, acv_estimate. ops can add fields but need the exact names and a ticket.

intake-bot: example payload accepted by intake service:
```
origin: marketplace|si|direct
partner_claim_ts: <unix_ts|null>
evidence_type: MOU|SOW|meeting_notes|null
evidence_url: https://...
first_paid_ts: <unix_ts|null>
acv_estimate: <number|null>
```
routing rules (pseudo):
```
if account.active_enterprise_contract == true -> owner=AE
else if evidence_type in [MOU,SOW] and evidence_ts < first_paid_ts -> owner=SI
else if origin==marketplace and days_since_purchase <= 30 -> owner=Marketplace
else if partner_claim_ts and days_between(partner_claim_ts, first_si_engagement_ts) <= 10 -> owner=SI
else if acv_estimate >= 250000 -> owner=AE_ESCALATE
else owner=Marketplace
```

Asha (Partnerships): add pilot exception: if SI ran >=2 technical sessions (logged in intake) -> owner=SI. intake-bot should post to #partners-atlashw on SI owner route and ping partner DRI.

Gavin (Marketplace): agree. also we need provisional crediting rules visible in lead notes until legal finalizes splits.

Omar (SI-Partner): request webhook when owner=AE_ESCALATE to create a thread in #partners-escalate and notify the SI DRI.

Rory (Ops): noted. will open ticket CRM-4901 to add fields + webhook wiring. ETA 4 business days.

Nina (Legal): I'll circulate partner addendum draft by next Tue with provisional crediting language.

Asha (Partnerships): action list: 1) Rory -> CRM ticket CRM-4901 (in flight) 2) Nina -> addendum draft (Tue) 3) Omar -> upload SI evidence for current leads (EOD) 4) Gavin -> flag marketplace-origin leads older than 30d. We'll reconvene after ops ticket. React when started.

intake-bot: calendar event: "AtlasHW SI routing dry-run" scheduled 2024-08-12 09:00 PT, invite sent.
